description: Adds a note to an existing contact in the partner's CRM and returns the new contact-event id. WRITE ACTION: this modifies partner CRM data. Requires the numeric contactId (e.g. from upsert_contact or find_contact_by_phone_or_email). If the contact does not exist, a plain-text not-found message is returned instead of throwing.

contactId.description: The numeric identifier of the contact to attach the note to.

name: add_contact_note
